3693-4659-5224-7183.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Gathering Stone, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2921-7084-8337.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.

2403-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3968-4050-4063-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4063-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Fleshtaker triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1 for each trigger.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4247-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
4247-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

4377-5913-7370.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from exile to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3946-4426-7804.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

requires.n: Equipment That Gives Haste to a Creature

924-4149-4599-4871--78.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871--78.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871--78.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
If needed, attach the Equipment that gives haste to Ghoulcallter Gisa.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871--78.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa. The chosen artifact to give haste must be activatable each loop using the additional Treasures. More creature tokens can be sacrificed each loop as desired/able to make more Treasures.

3249-5256-6586.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Vivi.
Cast Vivi by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Havengul Lich triggers, causing it to gain Vivi's activated abilities until end of turn.
Resolve Vivi. Then, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vivi.
Activate Havengul Lich using Vivi's ability by paying {0}, adding at least {2}{U}{R}.
Repeat.
3249-5256-6586.notes: If Havengul Lich's power is 5 or higher, you'll get infinite red and blue mana.

3259-4053-7604--161.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4053-7604--161.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with haste and mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature with haste and mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-7604--161.notes: The creatures with haste and mana value 3 or less can start either on the battlefield, in your graveyard, or a mix of the two. One of them can also have Breath of Fury attached to start. If either of these creatures start on the battlefield, they cannot have a finality counter on them.

560-5086-5183-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-5086-5183-5231-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

3490-4460-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4460-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1409-3128-6753.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve the Skullport Merchant trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-2919-3490-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2919-3490-6823.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3558-3967-5220-6900.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

560-4550-5572-5686.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-4550-5572-5686.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Dragon Appeasement triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Shilgengar abilities.
Repeat.

2438-4338-5929.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Leyline of Transformation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1874-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-3197-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2292-4063-6625.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You control another creature.
1339-2292-4063-6625.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

474-2034-4394-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4826-5003-6644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Affinity and a Generic Mana Cost

513--77.notablePrerequisites:
You can cast both affinity cards for {0}.
One of the affinity cards must be in your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
513--77.description:
Cast the card with affinity in your hand by paying {0}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the other affinity card from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Repeat.

413-1429-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-1429-5402-5929.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1719-5329-5475.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

1744-3487-3921-5770.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Aetherstorm Roc.
When the Aetherstorm Roc tokens enter the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers five times, causing you to get 60 {E}.
Activate Architect of the Untamed by paying eight {E}, creating a 6/6 Beast artifact creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, each Aetherstorm Roc you control triggers, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-4549-5006-5231.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Lurrus, adding {R}.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Thermopod ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

719-4338-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

431-1744-2557.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating ten token copies of Lullmage Mentor.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate a Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Each Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating twice that many 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1358-3272-4222-4289.notablePrerequisites: Immovable Rod does not have summoning sickness.
1358-3272-4222-4289.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, making Immovable Rod a creature in addition to it's other types.
Cast Freed from the Real enchanting Immovable Rod.
Activate Immovable Rod by tapping it to add {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U} to untap Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

350-2034-4963.notablePrerequisites:
Beck/ Call in hand.
You have a way to draw a card, an additional creature in hand to cast, or an additional {4}{W}{U}.
350-2034-4963.description:
Activate Words of Wilding.
Cast Beck, fusing it if you have the mana available, otherwise using some other way to draw a card.
Instead of drawing a card, create a 2/2 bear token.
Beck triggers.
Sacrifice the bear to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.Allow Mana Echoes to resolve, adding {C} for each bear you control.
Before Beck's trigger resolves, activate Words of Wilding, replacing your next draw with the creation of a 2/2 bear.
Repeat for infinite colorless mana, then repeat without sacrificing the bears for infinite bears.

1259-4872.notablePrerequisites: You do not have any instants or sorceries in your graveyard.
1259-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Charmbreaker Devils triggers, gaining +4/+0 until end of turn.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Charmbreaker Devils triggers, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Repeat.
